dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave trailing edge spline curve from apex to dorsal junction.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 60 degrees relative to the dorsal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1 ratio between the maximum pixel base width and vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Defined obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon curvature meets the rostrum plane.
